result.description: Compact fictional desktop audio console for in-car and home use, combining an FM transmitter, microSD playback, and Bluetooth call relay. Features a matte graphite shell, dual rotary controls, OLED status strip, and USB-C power input. Designed for short-range broadcast, voice passthrough, and ambient lighting presets rather than storage or graphics workloads.
result.title: Lunaris EchoLoop FM Transmitter Console
